meta.name: eol-stakeholder-sequence
meta.description: Plan who to talk to about a sunset, in what order, and what each conversation must cover. Use when an EOL decision is made and you want the landmines found before the announcement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划下架前与各方沟通的先后顺序和要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果计划产品下架，需要在公告前梳理关键沟通对象与内容。
copy.tagline_en: Plan who to talk to about a sunset, in what order, and what to cover.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan a product sunset and need to map key conversations before the announcement.

howto.what: 它会为产品下架规划谈话顺序：按规模分成三档，默认先谈法务、财务，再谈销售、客服，并列出每次谈话要问对方什么、要交代什么、要留意的危险信号，以及必须产出的决定。
howto.when: 当你已经决定停用某款产品，并希望在正式公告前找出潜在风险时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划停用旧版报表模块时该先和谁谈。
say.note: 它会按默认档位排出谈话顺序和要点。

say.text: 我们要下架一条硬件产品线，有8家经销商，先找谁？
say.note: 会按重度场景排序，并提示经销商的谈话内容。

say.text: 给这次产品停用排一份利益相关者谈话清单，标出每站的红旗。
say.note: 会列出每站要问什么、交代什么、留意什么。

howto.what_en: Plans who to talk to first for a sunset, and what each talk covers. Sorts by light/standard/heavy, defaults to legal first then finance/sales/support, and lists per stop: need, owe, red flags, output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an EOL decision is made and the user wants to find landmines before the announcement. Also when they ask to sequence stakeholder talks for a sunset.

say_en.text: Plan the stakeholder conversation order for retiring our legacy reporting module.
say_en.note: It will build a sequence ordered by default level.

say_en.text: We're sunsetting a hardware line with 8 resellers. Who do we talk to first?
say_en.note: It will rank stops for a heavy-level sunset.

say_en.text: Make a stakeholder list for this sunset with red flags per stop.
say_en.note: It lists what to ask, owe, and watch for.
